draft.emotion: energetic and urgent, urging someone to keep up the pace
notes: Use 'nhanh' to describe both physical speed (running fast) and the time aspect of doing something quickly.
Do not confuse it with 'sớm', which strictly means 'early' in time rather than high speed.

senses.definition: Moving or capable of moving with high speed.
Done or occurring in a short time.
